structure: Part 2, Dashboard and notification actions. Read in full: dashboard.fit.spec.js (15 tests in 6 describes) and notification-actions.fit.spec.js (4 tests), and all 19 trace zips the part names. The zips were written by a newer Playwright than tim's trace viewer can open (TraceVersionError on `open`), so each trace was read from its unpacked folder in the part2 working folder (d01-d15 = the 15 dashboard traces in read order, n1-n4 = the 4 notification-actions traces; each folder's title was checked against its spec line). Rendered DOM came from the frame snapshots in each trace's 1-trace.trace, the action list from test.trace, and the network log from 1-trace.network. Pages in this slice, in journey order: (1) sign-in stub redirect into the dashboard; (2) the dashboard at /live-animals, seen empty (d01, d14), with one draft (d05, d06, d12, d15, n1), one submitted (d03, d04), one amending (d07), two drafts (d08, d10, n3), 21 drafts over two pages (d11), and with a no-match search (d09); (3) the origin page reached from Start a new notification (d02), and the origin page reopened on a copied draft (n2); (4) the notification overview (hub) reached after amend (d07), after copy (n1, n2, n4) and at the end of the start helper (d13). Conditional: row actions depend on status (Draft, Submitted, Amending); the empty text shows only with no notifications and no search; the no-match copy shows only with a search; pagination shows only above 20 rows. Delete and cancel-amend destinations are part 3 and were not followed here; the full journey pages the staging helpers walk through (commodities to declaration) belong to other parts and are only cited where they set up a dashboard state.
